title: Space Pinball
description: A streamlined pinball game with a static cosmic table, responsive flippers, comet trails and atmospheric music. Build the reactor and earn three-ball Supernova.

defaultCaptions.x: Ignite. Align. Release. Play Space Pinball and earn three-ball Supernova.
defaultCaptions.discord: Space Pinball: skill shots, shot chains, three-ball Supernova and local high scores. Play with keyboard or touch.
